profile_text.body:
Celestica Inc. is a public company headquartered in Toronto, Ontario, and trades under the ticker CLS. On its own website, the company describes itself as a technology leader with expertise in design, engineering, and manufacturing, and says it works across high-growth markets. It states that it engineers, designs, and manufactures what it calls the backbone of AI and cloud technology, and that it enables critical data center infrastructure for AI, cloud, and hybrid cloud. The company also cites supply chain and platform solutions among its capabilities and points to a global network and its team as advantages it offers customers.

The company's own description places it in the AI and cloud infrastructure supply chain rather than in AI software or models. No specific AI products, litigation, or other regulatory or patent matters are recorded for Celestica in the available material.
